rationale.reason: Local gas/water/sewer/hot-water/steam pipelines match; complete treatment plants and long-distance networks remain distinct.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR concerns the actual installed local gas pipelines, local water and sewer mains, and local hot-water and steam pipelines, delivered as complete physical civil entities (un-cpc3-2025, printed/PDF p.280). Local water/sewer mains are distinct from treatment plants (p.281). The method is needed for medium-specific joints, network interfaces, chambers, thermal protection and actual acceptance construction; classification alone does not establish identity. Manufactured pipe methods can supply upstream evidence, but do not replace this installed entity. Long-distance transmission, nonpipeline aqueducts, treatment/generating plants, internal building plumbing and separately purchased construction services are outside this category.

Use the entire owner-defined main/network between surveyed interfaces, including actually delivered junctions, chambers, valves, supports, branch connections, condensate return where applicable and contracted reinstatement. An independently accepted reach is permissible only when its physical scope and complete interfaces are documented; never omit inconvenient crossings or thermal/acceptance work by choosing a smaller material route. A data package for a genuinely partial delivery remains explicitly incomplete.

The foreground is construction from recorded preconstruction site and supplied-material states through actual inspection, tests, corrections and acceptance. Supplier manufacture is separately linked upstream; ordinary conveyance, heating/pumping after handover, maintenance, replacement and eventual dismantling/fates are separate stages. This is neither automatically complete cradle-to-gate nor a full-life method. No default lifetime, capacity, pipe mass per metre, mix ratio, loss or energy rate is supplied. HK mainlaying/civil specifications and the US heat guide/report inform their stated routes, not global compliance or default numeric requirements.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete accepted local gas pipelines; water/sewer mains; hot-water/steam pipelines with integral declared works
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Long-distance lines; aqueducts without pipelines; treatment/generating plants; building plumbing; manufactured pipe/components; services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Installed complete civil entity at its declared site, actually accepted for the specified duty and interface configuration

scientific_review.scope: Independent semantic, engineering-acceptance, allocation and source-applicability review remain required. No publication or methodology approval claimed.

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: When actual trench/pit shoring uses steel sheet piles. Record actual installation/removal energy separately; the input is the supported manufacture share of the same measured steel component, with cumulative shares conserved across all projects. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Record only soil actually exported as waste after documented contamination screening and destination classification. Soil moved and reused within the declared site boundary is an internal balance, not a second external exchange. Contaminated soil needs its own identified waste row. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Conditional actual external transfer to treatment. Record suspended-solids state and any measured contamination; this liquid waste is neither natural resource intake nor a direct environmental discharge. Internal settling/reuse remains internal. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual DI water-main route only: document grade, bore, wall, lining, coating, joint and actual supplied net mass. Include factory lining/coating within the supplied pipe boundary; do not add its constituents again. Cast-steel and generic iron families do not establish this configured pipe identity. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

When the actual accepted water route uses certified PE100 pressure pipe, with diameter, SDR/wall, resin and joint procedure recorded. This water-grade row does not substitute for gas-grade or an unspecified plastic pipe. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual PE gas-main route only, using the specific certified gas grade, dimensions, joining qualification and operating conditions. Do not infer material grade, pressure rating or gas approval from water-pipe identity. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual precast reinforced-concrete sewer route, including declared reinforcement and factory joint components. Capture net measured mass/geometry and joint method; do not count embedded reinforcement again. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual vitrified-clay sewer route, with bore, wall, supplied joint state and measured net quantity; this fired pipe is distinct from loose clay feedstock or concrete pipe. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual discrete DI elbow with angle, bore, lining/coating and supplied boundary; exclude any elbow already included in a purchased assembly. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual discrete DI tee; identify each branch diameter and supplied coating/lining. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual complete gate valve with bore, pressure class, actuator and supplied internal component boundary. Other valve types, gas regulators, steam traps or hydrants require their own discrete rows. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only a separately supplied actual EPDM gasket with confirmed elastomer formulation and fluid/temperature compatibility. Do not default to EPDM for every pipe route or duplicate a gasket included in the supplied pipe/valve. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately supplied gas-grade PE electrofusion coupling; retain dimensions and joining record. Butt fusion without a supplied coupling does not create this exchange. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual covered-electrode field welding only; retain classification, coating and issued-minus-returned mass. MIG wire, flux and shielding gases each need separate actual rows. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual prepared epoxy formulation applied to field joints, with composition, mixing state, curing and solvent content declared. Record its constituents separately only if mixed from individual purchased products, replacing the formulated-product row. Actual VOC species require separate supported releases. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual solvent-cement joint route only, with supplier formulation and issued/returned quantity. Socket-ring routes without solvent adhesive do not use this row. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual separately delivered fresh mix for included chamber/base/thrust works; retain grade, mix certificate, density, placement volume, rejects and curing. Precast chamber assemblies replace their embedded materials; on-site mixing requires separate cement, each aggregate, water and each admixture plus actual mixing energy. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately supplied rebar installed in declared civil works; retain grade, cut lengths and weights. Embedded reinforcement of precast components is excluded from this separate row. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately installed polyethylene identification tape; retain tape material and measured length/linear mass. Conductive detectable tape with metal content requires its own component identity. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual uncoated steel offcuts exported as waste; coated/contaminated offcuts and spent electrodes are separate waste identities. No recycling credit is inferred. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual PE cut/rejected pipe waste at the site handoff before washing/recycling; cleaned polymer at a recycling plant is a different interface. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual uPVC offcuts exported with contamination and destination declared; do not combine with polyethylene scrap. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual DI offcuts with lining/coating state and destination documented. Steel scrap is not automatically this waste. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual trenchless drilling/lubrication route using separately supplied bentonite. Retain real mud recipe and each separately purchased additive; injection-well bentonite/cellulose mixture is not pure powder. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual complete supplied cement grout for annular void filling; record composition and wet state. Actual spent slurry transferred out after measured recovery/reuse; retain bentonite concentration, mineral solids, contamination and wet volume. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately supplied high-temperature calcium-silicate sections in the specified heat system. UFGS WSL steam systems distinguish an inner high-temperature layer from outer foam; do not infer generic thickness, density or suitability from a mineral feedstock. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

When actual certified rock-wool pipe sections suit the recorded operating temperature and system design. A generic loose mineral wool identity does not alone confirm binder/form, temperature duty or thickness. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only an actual separately supplied outer PU layer with composition and thermal duty documented. In the cited WSL steam arrangement this surrounds the calcium-silicate layer; never treat PU directly on every steam carrier as a universal route. Count factory-embedded foam only inside its purchased assembly. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately supplied DDT-system steel casing with declared coating, vent/drain and field-connection boundary; it is not the fluid carrier and not a default WSL or HDPE casing. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately supplied WSL glass-fibre/polyester casing, with construction and resin documented. Complete supplied casing is one physical component; do not separately add its embedded resin and glass fibres. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual separately supplied anchor/support with geometry and load/configuration evidence; concrete block is accounted in its concrete row. Other expansion joints or steam traps require their own specific supplied-component rows. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual reinstatement of disturbed asphalt pavement before acceptance, with mix type, binder, reclaimed content, layer dimensions and measured quantity. Do not attribute undisturbed roads or future maintenance to this construction. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual removed pavement exported during this construction/restoration; retain tar screening, contamination and destination. Coal-tar waste or concrete rubble need different rows. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual supply outside the verified HK interface requires its own provider/geography/treatment identity. Record all fills, flushes, drain-down and repeat tests; use this row instead of, not in addition to, the same hk_test_water quantity. Pneumatic-only tests do not require invented water. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual potable-water commissioning that uses this disinfectant, with solution composition, active-chlorine assay, density and issued dose measured. The WSD concentrations/contact times are HK specification context, not global default recipes. Sewer/gas/heat lines do not automatically use disinfection. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual pneumatic tests; declare moisture, pressure, temperature and supply boundary. Purchased compressed air and on-site compression electricity are alternative production boundaries; avoid counting both as complete supplied utilities. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Conditional actual gas connection/test charge before acceptance, with composition, fossil/biogenic fractions, state and measured mass/volume conversion. Retained line pack at handover is distinguished from consumed/vented gas; subsequent distributed gas and routine operating loss are outside construction. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Only actual pre-handover operational tests: collect supplier pressure, temperature, steam quality and actual supply/condensate interface. Neither 0.45 MPaG nor 11 MPaG is assumed. Boiler production is linked upstream unless actually on site, where each real fuel/water/emission must be inventoried. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Actual collected test/flush water sent to external treatment; retain contact materials, chemistry and treatment route. Actual discarded film, separate from PE pipe offcuts and with contamination/recycling destination declared. Bounded public candidate search and direct originals have not established an exact compatible identity; the declared concrete physical exchange is retained.

Bounded public search and direct candidate review have not established a compatible supplied/returned fluid interface; retain the actual atomic exchange and resolve identity separately.

evidence_needs: Actual project geometry, material/configuration, quantities, mixtures, meter records and acceptance evidence are collected through the protocols; no default amounts are asserted.
Compatible upstream links and optional additional atomic exchanges must be independently established for each actual project.
Reusable equipment/component lifetime or cumulative actual activity and conserved manufacture shares require real evidence; unknown bases remain review.
Direct noise/vibration, land occupation and ecological disturbance need explicit quantified scope/evidence before a dataset claims their coverage.

identity_decision: Reuse authored content under the retained original ID and directory; remove redundant candidate directory.
